skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Clivia
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Clivia. Handmade by Lungmen craftsman, this outfit enjoys several benefits from its high-tech materials: light weight, breathability and durability. Furthermore, its waterproof fabric possesses high thermal performance, making it practical and exquisite at the same time. Limited edition.
skins.quote: I'd like to try an Eastern-style outfit every now and then.

skins.name: Ash
skins.content:
Vitafield
[Rewilder] Series Classics/Ash. Wind-resistant, dust-resistant, heat-resistant, and durable.
skins.usage: One of Jessica's special work clothes.
skins.quote: Missions can give you a hard time. Hang in there.

skins.name: Iron Block
skins.content: Pioneer Series/Iron Block. An extremely durable product designed by Raythean Industrial, made for the harshest of environments. With the perfect combination of advanced technology and rare materials, it provides the best protection that money can buy.
skins.usage: Special work clothes designed by Raythean Industrial.
skins.quote: For those who prioritize their safety.
